monsters.name: Goblin
dialogue: Hehehe! Time to take your shiny coins!
You look weak... this will be fun!
Goblins always win! You will lose!

responses.taunt: Goblins NEVER back down! I'll show you!
responses.intimidate: O-okay! Maybe I run... but next time, I win!
responses.negotiate: Hmm... Maybe we can talk? You give me gold, I let you live.

monsters.name: Bandit
dialogue: Hand over your gold, and I *might* let you live!
Another fool wandering these roads... big mistake.
This is my territory! Your life belongs to me now!

responses.taunt: Hah! You think you’re tough? I’ll cut that arrogance out of you!
responses.intimidate: Alright, alright! No need for violence! I’ll be on my way.
responses.negotiate: You want to pay your way out? 30 gold, and I let you go.

monsters.name: Wild Wolf
dialogue: 🐺 *The wolf snarls, baring its fangs!*
🐺 *A deep growl echoes through the trees...*
🐺 *The wolf circles you, ready to pounce!*

responses.taunt: 🐺 *The wolf howls angrily and lunges at you!*
responses.intimidate: 🐺 *The wolf hesitates... then backs away into the forest.*
responses.negotiate: 🐺 *The wolf doesn’t understand your offer and attacks!*

monsters.name: Skeleton Warrior
dialogue: 💀 *Bones rattle as the skeleton advances!*
💀 *A hollow voice echoes: 'You shall join the undead!'*
💀 *The skeleton raises its rusted sword...*

responses.taunt: 💀 *The skeleton cackles, brandishing its rusted sword.* 'Then let’s dance, mortal!'
responses.intimidate: 💀 *It seems unfazed. Death does not fear threats.*
responses.negotiate: 💀 *The skeleton stares at you. It does not understand.*

monsters.name: Orc Brute
dialogue: RAARGH! Orc SMASH puny human!
You fight Orc? Orc fight BACK!
Give me your weapons, or I take them from your corpse!

responses.taunt: HAHA! You have big words! LET'S FIGHT!
responses.intimidate: Orc is strong... but maybe not today. Orc leave.
responses.negotiate: Give me 30 gold, I let you go.

monsters.name: Shadow Figure
dialogue: 🕷️ *The shadow looms closer... wisps of smoke trail behind it.*
🕷️ *A distorted voice whispers: 'Your end is near...'*
🕷️ *The shadow shifts, becoming more defined with every step...*

responses.taunt: 🕷️ *'You amuse me... but death is certain.'*

monsters.name: Bandit Leader
dialogue: 💀 'I've cut down tougher than you!'
💀 'Surrender now, and maybe I'll leave you breathing.'
💀 'Your gold... or your life!'

responses.intimidate: 💀 'Ha! I've stared death in the face before... and laughed.'
responses.negotiate: 💀 'You can bribe me... but it'll cost you dearly.'

monsters.name: Demon
dialogue: 🔥 Mortal, you dare challenge me?!
🔥 Your soul will burn in the eternal flames!
🔥 This world belongs to us now, weakling!

responses.taunt: 🔥 Foolish human! You only hasten your doom!
responses.intimidate: 🔥 You think I fear YOU?! HAHAHA! Prepare for eternal suffering!
responses.negotiate: 🔥 You amuse me. Leave now, and I shall spare you... for a price.

monsters.name: Ancient Dragon
dialogue: 🐉 'You dare disturb my slumber?'
🐉 'Your bones will burn in dragonfire!'
🐉 'I will feast upon your charred remains!'

responses.taunt: 🐉 'Foolish mortal... your courage will be your undoing!'
responses.intimidate: 🐉 'Intimidation? HA! I have ruled these skies for centuries!'
responses.negotiate: 🐉 'Bribery? Perhaps your gold may delay your death... but not for long.'

monsters.name: Winged Wyvern
dialogue: 🦇 'I will strike from the sky!'
🦇 'You cannot run from my claws!'
🦇 'Scream loud... I enjoy the sound!'

responses.taunt: 🦇 'Your insults bore me... prepare to die!'
responses.intimidate: 🦇 'You think I fear you? I will feast on your corpse!'
responses.negotiate: 🦇 'Bah! Your gold is useless to me!'

monsters.name: Basilisk
dialogue: 🐍 'Look into my eyes... and become stone!'
🐍 'You are no match for me, mortal!'
🐍 'My gaze will end your pitiful life!'

responses.taunt: 🐍 'Foolish! Now stare into my eyes and perish!'
responses.intimidate: 🐍 'Hisss... you think you can frighten ME?'
responses.negotiate: 🐍 'What can gold buy... when you are stone?'

monsters.name: Chimera
dialogue: 🦁🐐🐍 'Three heads... three ways to die!'
🦁🐐🐍 'We hunger for your flesh!'
🦁🐐🐍 'Your fate is sealed!'

responses.taunt: 🦁🐐🐍 'We love a challenge... but we love victory more!'
responses.intimidate: 🦁🐐🐍 'You can't scare three minds at once!'

monsters.name: Hydra
dialogue: 🐉🐉🐉 'Cut off one head... and three more shall rise!'
🐉🐉🐉 'You will drown in the blood of your fallen allies!'
🐉🐉🐉 'This is my domain... prepare to die!'

responses.taunt: 🐉🐉🐉 'Your words are weak... and so are you!'
responses.negotiate: 🐉🐉🐉 'Your gold is worthless... your life is what I seek!'

monsters.name: Mountain Giant
dialogue: 🏔️ 'I AM THE EARTH! TREMBLE BEFORE ME!'
🏔️ 'Your bones will break like twigs beneath my feet!'
🏔️ 'I will crush you like the insects you are!'
